assertions.name: covariance_epic_A2_hook_frullani_reduction
assertions.source: A2 (Cov(ln f,ω₃)≤0) reduced to Cov(H_s,ω₃)≤0 ∀s>0 via the hook identity Σh²=Σc²+n² and Frullani; integral rep verified n≤10, the reduced sign verified strictly<0 on the interior n≤13. Sharpening, not a proof. No fit; no c_k.

description: Attack A2 advance (qou-x631): reduce the transcendental Cov_Planch(ln f,ω₃)≤0 to a clean one-parameter hook-covariance sign. Hook-length formula: ln f=ln n!−Σ ln h, so Cov(ln f,ω₃)=−Σ_v ln(v)·ν_v, ν_v=Cov(N_v,ω₃) (N_v=#hooks of length v). Exact moments: Σν_v=0 (ΣN_v=n); Σv²ν_v=Cov(Σh²,ω₃)=Var(ω₃)=n(n−1)(n−2)/3 via the CLASSICAL IDENTITY Σ_□h²=Σ_□c²+n² (verified all λ). Frullani (ln v=∫(e^{−s}−e^{−vs})/s ds, Σν_v=0) gives the EXACT integral rep Cov(ln f,ω₃)=∫_0^∞(1/s)Cov(H_s,ω₃)ds, H_s=Σ_□ e^{−s h} (verified n≤10). Hence A2 ⇐ the pointwise sign Cov_Planch(H_s,ω₃)≤0 ∀s>0, VERIFIED strictly<0 on the interior (fine grid, n≤13). This replaces the ln-covariance by a one-parameter family of covariances of a positive analytic hook statistic. SHARPENS A2 (exact reduction); does NOT prove the kernel — Cov(H_s,ω₃)≤0 remains open (H_s, like ln f, is a hook functional ∉ the shifted-symmetric algebra A). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.hook_content_identity: sum h^2 = sum c^2 + n^2 (classical, verified all lambda)
data.reduced_target: Cov_Planch(H_s, omega3) <= 0 for all s>0, H_s = sum_box e^{-s h}
